name: Markout (inside tags)
comment: markout lets a tag hold comments between its attributes, the way JavaScript does -- HTML doesn't, and calls them illegal characters, so this injection claims them first. It only applies inside a tag: `//` in text is text, not a comment.

comment-line.comment: // to the end of the line -- which takes the `>` with it, as the parser does. It must start a word: this grammar is injected into every HTML file, and `<script src=//cdn.example.com/x.js>` is a protocol-relative URL, not a comment
comment-line.name: comment.line.double-slash.markout
